description: Rust toolchain pinning and core-engine fixes. Pin Rust 1.87.0 stable in rust-toolchain.toml. Fix Cargo.toml edition from '2024' to '2021'. Fix unused Sandbox.name field warning in cgroup.rs. Add tests for parse_meminfo_value and /proc/stat parsing. No HTTP server exists in core-engine (it's a CLI monitor), so no 0.0.0.0 binding fix needed.
steps: Create rust-toolchain.toml at repo root: [toolchain] channel = '1.87.0', components = ['rustfmt', 'clippy']
Fix core-engine/Cargo.toml: change edition = '2024' to edition = '2021'

Fix unused Sandbox.name field in core-engine/src/cgroup.rs: rename field to '_name' (indicates intentionally unused) OR add field-level #[allow(dead_code)] with comment explaining it's kept for future observability

Create core-engine/src/tests.rs with mod tests containing: test_parse_meminfo_value() testing parse_meminfo_value with realistic /proc/meminfo format strings (MemTotal, MemAvailable, edge cases like missing key); test_proc_stat_parsing() testing the logic from read_cpu_ticks that handles process names with spaces and parentheses — extract the parsing logic into a testable function if needed (e.g., parse_proc_stat_line(contents: &str) -> Option<(u64, u64)> that finds last ')' and parses utime/stime)
Add 'mod tests;' to core-engine/src/main.rs if tests.rs is a separate file, OR add #[cfg(test)] mod tests { } inline at the bottom of main.rs
Run cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings in core-engine/ and fix any issues
Run cargo test in core-engine/ and verify all tests pass
Commit: git add rust-toolchain.toml core-engine/ && git commit -m 'fix(core): pin Rust 1.87.0, fix edition 2021, fix unused field warning, add tests'
acceptance_criteria: rust-toolchain.toml exists with channel 1.87.0 and components rustfmt, clippy
core-engine/src/cgroup.rs has no unused field warnings
core-engine/src/tests.rs or inline tests exist with test_parse_meminfo_value and test_proc_stat_parsing
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passes with zero warnings
cargo test passes with all tests green
